name: binance_vision_collector-mcp
description: Binance Vision historical CDN (market data): me, get_candles, search_symbols. Every tool maps to a d

tools.name: me
tools.description: Public market-data host, no credentials: the probe is GET /api/v3/ping (weight 1, empty object).

tools.name: get_candles
tools.description: Kline/candlestick rows are positional arrays [openTime, open, high, low, close, volume, closeTime, quoteVolume, trades, takerBuyBase, takerBuyQuote, ignore] mapped by index (`raw.values` keeps the row). `interval`: 1s, 1m, 3m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 4h, 6h, 8h, 12h, 1d, 3d, 1w, 1M. `start`/`end` are startTime/endTime in epoch MILLISECONDS (pass the number as a string); `time` is the open time in ms and prices/volume are Binance's decimal strings. limit default 500, max 1000 (weight 2). Rows carry prices as decimal strings (and Binance the open time as an integer); they are returned as numbers and `time` as a string, as the vocabulary types them (live check 2026-09-26: the raw values failed the output schema).

tools.name: search_symbols
tools.description: exchangeInfo has no text search: `query` is sent as the exact `symbol` filter (e.g. BTCUSDT; an unknown symbol is a 400 'Invalid symbol' error) and the whole symbol list comes back when it is omitted — pagination is not supported, `page`/`limit` are ignored. `name` is the baseAsset, `type` the trading status; quoteAsset, precisions, orderTypes, permissions and filters stay in `raw`.
